Frontend Playwright 19/19 checks pass: manager sees [month-revenue-masked]='••••••', gold [month-revenue-reveal-btn] with Lock icon, hint 'locked by owner · tap the lock · owner PIN'; [staff-performance-card] shows [perf-locked] with 'Locked by the owner' + [perf-unlock-btn], all [perf-tab-*] disabled. Wrong PIN 0000 → 'Incorrect PIN' toast, card stays locked. PIN 4321 → perf-locked gone, [perf-rows] visible, tabs enabled; clicking [perf-tab-last_month] shows 3 rows including Priya Sharma & Rahul Verma. [month-revenue-reveal-btn] + 4321 → [kpi-revenue-month] shows '₹15,989' with 'unlocked for 15s · hides again automatically' hint and [month-revenue-hide-btn]; after 17s auto-remasks back to '••••••'. Owner (admin@miracurl.com) dashboard: [month-revenue-lock-btn] present with amber Lock icon (hide=ON), month value shows masked+eye (owner peeks without PIN — data.month_revenue_locked=false), Business by Stylist renders directly with no [perf-locked]. Tenant hide_month_revenue restored to TRUE at end.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx (line 136): monthMasked derives from data.month_revenue_hidden_for_staff && !showMonth regardless of role — this is intentional so the owner can also 'peek' but it means the owner-only revenue is briefly hidden on first paint even though hide_month_revenue was meant to hide from *managers/staff*. Consider gating monthMasked on `!isAdmin || data.month_revenue_hidden_for_staff` explicitly (already effectively so, but the naming is confusing).

ownerPin.js getWithFreshPin: does not cache the PIN — every reveal or perf-unlock re-prompts. If the manager unlocks perf, then taps the reveal button, they enter PIN again. This is safer but a small UX friction; consider re-using cachedPin for reads within the same session.

Unrelated console warning during owner load: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' from MiraDayOffer.jsx line 55 — pre-existing hydration issue (not related to iter-184 but visible in dashboard console).
